summary: PRSearchStudents is a data access and business logic layer for retrieving and managing student Placement Request (PR) history records, typically representing clinical placements in health-related academic programs. It provides multiple search and retrieval workflows for staff, supervisors, instructors, and students. It manages field-level and workflow-level business rules for access, formatting, record filtering, and status calculations.
purpose: To support retrieval and display of Placement Request history for students and their associated parties (staff, supervisors, instructors) in a secure, context-aware, and role-sensitive manner, including sorting, field-level masking, formatting, and conditional logic based on business rules, user roles, and data state.

workflows.name: StudentSearchPRHistory
steps: Validate session and retrieve student ID.
Determine allowed lists for sites, services, destinations, sub-disciplines (role-dependent).
Execute stored procedure 'StudentSearchPRHistory' with session, student ID, and agency ID.
For each result, build PRSearchStudent entry.
Apply access/masking rules: remove or hide data if not confirmed or not allowed.
Format fields (dates, names, durations, statuses) per business/UI requirements.
Apply color coding, warnings, and icons for amended hours, notes, consent expiries, etc.
Optionally filter by assignment status and archived status.
Return collection.

workflows.name: SupervisorSearchPRHistory
steps: Accept supervisor ID, sort expression, and PRHistoryOnly flag.
Get all supervisor-related PRSearchStudent entries.
Order by provided sort expression (StartDate, Course, Site, Status, etc.).
Apply data masking, show/hide details per allowed lists and masking rules.
Return results.

workflows.name: InstructorSearchPRHistory
steps: Accept instructor ID, editability flag, sort expression, and private mode flag.
Determine allowed lists for current session (private mode check).
Filter PRs by site/service/destination/sub-discipline access and agency matches.
Mask/omit data if outside allowed lists.
For each entry, format and return fields as per UI/business rules.

workflows.name: StaffPlacementSearchHistory
steps: For staff, retrieve Placement Requests using staff ID, agency ID, and session data.
Fill list with context-based allowed lists for sites, services, destinations.
Enforce masking/hiding using same allowed-list logic.
Format and filter results as above.

business_rules: Only show PR details if user is allowed for the specified site/service/destination/sub-discipline.
If user is Student and PR is not Confirmed and not released to temp student, mask key fields (IDs, site/service/destination, etc.).
If consent is expired, remove or hide name fields unless session is SystemAdmin.
Archived records may replace 'Details' links with comment icons if comment alert is set.
Only display actual PRs (by PRD_ID != 0) when required.
Do not show enrollment-only (non-placement) entries or held PRs in private mode.
Hours shown in red if the difference between entered and expected hours is greater than 8 (MIN_HOUR_DIFFERENCE) or hours otherwise do not match.
Rows are hidden if outside current user's allowed lists unless all are allowed.
validations: PRD_ID and StudentID must be > 0 to allow updates.
DurationAmendedHours cannot be negative (unless set to -99, indicating unset/not applicable).
Warn or highlight if DurationHoursAmended differs significantly (using MIN_HOUR_DIFFERENCE) from DurationHours or ExpectedDurationHours.
Suppress/hide details if access is not allowed (site/service/destination/sub-discipline checks).
calculations: DurationHoursFormatted combines actual and expected hours, with color coding if hours differ by more than 8.
ExpectedDurationHoursFormatted for split parents: sum actual + (group size) and compare; show in red if mismatched.
ASMResultsFormatted renders rank/assignment preference metrics for 'ASM-matched' parent PRDs.
GroupSizeFormatted handles alternate observations and formatting.
conditions: Display varies by user role/context (private mode, placement coordinator, instructor, system admin, student, etc.).
Different workflows for supervisors, instructors, staff, and students.
system_behavior: All retrievals can optionally sort by StartDate, CourseShortName, Site, StatusCode, etc.
Formatting is handled for UI display (e.g. masking fields, showing tooltips, highlighting differences, showing icons).
Mask or omit data when not allowed by business rules or allowed lists.
Return values as lists of PRSearchStudent objects, ready for UI binding or further processing.
dependencies: AllowedLists (determines access to records by role and agency)
Resources strings for localization, labels, tooltips
exceptions: Omit entries where user does not have allowed access.
If consent is expired and user is not admin, name fields are blanked.
If entry is not confirmed and not released, or is held, suppress details for students.
content_gaps: Full stored procedure logic for DB access is not provided, so some filtering/logic is inferred from parameter usage and function signatures.
UI logic and resource string exact outputs are not always available (e.g., exact formatting for icons).
Some edge business rules depend on external types (e.g., AllowedList, StringUtil, UI.Formatters) and resource files, which are referenced but not detailed.
